description: Search Egleze for attribution-verified public podcast moments by keyword, topic/category, and/or date range. Returns Egleze-written headlines and short summaries with canonical links. Does not return full transcripts or quotes. Records privacy-safe operational telemetry for reliability and aggregate usage measurement.

category.description: Filter by Egleze topic/category, e.g. "AI & Tech"

query.description: Keyword(s) to match in the headline/summary, e.g. "AI safety"

since.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD); only moments on/after this date

until.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD); only moments on/before this date

name: search_moments
title: Search Egleze moments
